scenarios.setup: Scan generated EPUB, translation EPUB, PDF, FB2 and comics twice after the stability window
scenarios.expect: Distinct editions/files; strong title evidence links only compatible works; no title-text-only collapse

scenarios.setup: Move a uniquely fingerprinted ebook within its library
scenarios.expect: Same edition/file/version and usable saved locator

scenarios.setup: Replace a scanned ebook at the same path, then replay an old location
scenarios.expect: Same edition/file, new version; 412 with durable candidate, no old locator applied

scenarios.setup: Reader A has ebook-only library A; reader B and admin lack that grant
scenarios.expect: A can GET/HEAD/range exact ebook bytes; other callers denied before bytes; no recording row required

scenarios.setup: Generate a real CFI from each reflowable engine; reload with different font and viewport
scenarios.expect: Resume same text within the exact version; unsupported locator profiles explicitly disabled

scenarios.setup: Select text on rotated/cropped PDF; change zoom, rotation and reload
scenarios.expect: Unrotated crop-normalized position/highlight round trips without pixel drift

scenarios.setup: Pages named 2.png, 10.png, nested paths and numeric/case ties
scenarios.expect: Stable documented numeric ordering and entry identities; no overwritten duplicate path

scenarios.setup: Read forward then deliberately save an earlier exact location at current revision
scenarios.expect: Earlier location accepted; percentage/clock never chooses winner

scenarios.setup: Two sessions write from the same revision, then resolve while a third writes
scenarios.expect: 409 preserves candidate; resume asks; racing resolution creates another explicit conflict

scenarios.setup: Lose successful response and retry identical operation; then reuse ID with changed payload
scenarios.expect: Identical status/body and no duplicate state/history; changed request rejected

scenarios.setup: Navigate to last page then explicitly finish one edition with a sibling edition present
scenarios.expect: No automatic finish; explicit finish updates only that edition and ebook history

scenarios.setup: Reader B/admin attempts A highlight read/write; shared shelf references same title
scenarios.expect: No private note or quote leaks through shelf, filters, conflicts or admin counts

scenarios.setup: Edit/delete concurrently, then replay old edit after deletion and reload
scenarios.expect: Tombstone retained; stale candidate recoverable; no resurrection; duplicate delete idempotent

scenarios.setup: Select text in reflowable/PDF and create image-comic page note/bookmark
scenarios.expect: Verified highlights persist; image comic text highlight unavailable with explicit reason

scenarios.setup: Owner shares manual shelf across two libraries; viewer has one grant; viewer tries editing
scenarios.expect: Only owner edits; viewer sees permitted titles/counts only, never hidden UUIDs or private owner state

scenarios.setup: Owner and viewer differ in completion; shared smart filter asks unfinished fiction
scenarios.expect: Each sees own allowed matches; public catalog filters and own state only

scenarios.setup: Submit SQL-like field, overly deep/wide filters, wrong operator/type or 513-char value
scenarios.expect: 422; no query code executes and no unbounded evaluation

scenarios.setup: Two tabs reorder/add/remove at one shelf revision, with inaccessible members retained
scenarios.expect: One succeeds and one durable 409; hidden membership not exposed/deleted; retry never duplicates

scenarios.setup: Delete shared shelf, then replay stale owner writes or fetch as non-owner
scenarios.expect: Owner retains tombstone/conflict; non-owner sees 404; no recreation by stale retry

scenarios.setup: Open synthetic book with inline/external/blob scripts, SVG events and hostile links
scenarios.expect: No script execution, parent/API/session access or unexpected network/navigation under actual CSP

scenarios.setup: Send messages from another frame, prior book channel or oversized range/annotation payload
scenarios.expect: Ignored/rejected; no arbitrary URL fetch or mutation; logout closes reader and channel

scenarios.setup: Run pristine Foliate and direct PDF.js/worker under actual production reader headers
scenarios.expect: Selected formats work without CSP relaxation, CDN, credentials or opaque-origin module errors

scenarios.setup: Feed traversal/absolute paths, links, duplicate normalized names and nested archives
scenarios.expect: Rejected before page publication; only private cache affected; originals unchanged

scenarios.setup: Exceed each accepted compressed/expanded/ratio/count/pixel/time/concurrency ceiling
scenarios.expect: Bounded streaming abort with typed reason; no partial ready manifest or uncontrolled memory/disk

scenarios.setup: Interrupt extraction and restart; fill cache while two active extraction reservations exist
scenarios.expect: Durable jobs recover or fail cleanly; inactive cache evicted, active readers protected, budget respected

scenarios.setup: Revoke grant while a reader, comic extraction and pending writes are active
scenarios.expect: Further requests denied; protected view cleared on detection, pending data locked and not sent

scenarios.setup: Drop network, edit note, reload, log out, switch account, return and sign in
scenarios.expect: Original pending op durable and locked by server/user; no false saved indicator or cross-user replay

scenarios.setup: Browser login/restore/logout and mutation with missing/wrong CSRF; bearer regression
scenarios.expect: Cookie remains HttpOnly, existing transport semantics preserved, wrong CSRF rejected

scenarios.setup: Play generated three-file recording, seek cross-file chapter, pause/reload/conflict/finish
scenarios.expect: Exact file/version resume and T003 natural-end completion; no percentage fallback

scenarios.setup: Merge two disjoint recordings with distinct per-user positions and finished states
scenarios.expect: New successor unfinished/no canonical resume; source IDs/states/history retained and candidates explicit

scenarios.setup: Split one recording with progress in different files into complete ordered partitions
scenarios.expect: New successor identities; candidates only where anchored file belongs; no automatic finish

scenarios.setup: Approve then replace a source file/layout; execute twice or race two plans
scenarios.expect: 412 on obsolete plan; transaction atomic; replay applied plan returns same successor IDs

scenarios.setup: Old client GET snapshot and writes progress after repair
scenarios.expect: 409 snapshot and 412 write with authorized successor hints; candidate preserved; unrelated recordings unaffected

scenarios.setup: Use existing T004 protected edits, clears, reviews, copy-only import and writer status
scenarios.expect: Real preview/approval and error UI; backups remain off by default; no fake enabled in-file writer

scenarios.setup: Load nested SPA route, unknown API/reader asset and range media URL
scenarios.expect: SPA loads navigation only; API/assets/media never receive index HTML; development proxy retains CSRF

scenarios.setup: Keyboard-only and narrow touch viewport through catalog/reader/audio/shelf/conflict workflows
scenarios.expect: Focus/labels/dialogs/controls usable; loading/error/empty/incomplete states visible

scenarios.setup: Exercise all accepted ebook/comic/audio families, fixed layout, encrypted/damaged and large variants
scenarios.expect: Capability matrix states observed recognition/read/play/highlight/resume results and limits per browser

scenarios.setup: Review scripts and GitHub Actions setting before handoff
scenarios.expect: No CI reactivation, publication, tags, signing or legacy migration implementation
